assessment: Parent artifact reconciliation of the fresh Planner extension workflow, not an independent effectiveness study or a 29-feature pass.

classification.OBSERVED_WITH_LIMITS: The named behavior has concrete artifact or execution support; this is not exhaustive branch coverage or authenticated role independence.
classification.PARTIAL: Useful behavior is supported, but part of the inventoried observation contract remains unproved.
classification.BLOCKED: An applicable workflow capability or required completion gate could not run successfully.
classification.NOT_EXERCISED: This increment did not exercise the relevant conditional workflow branch.

limits: The exercise extended an existing medium-complexity app; it was not a fresh-from-empty build.
Research, design and review roles are reported by retained artifacts; no authenticated identity or hidden-context audit is claimed.
Human design/UX approval remains unconfirmed under the explicit unattended authorization.
Guarded mode was never adopted. Direct commands and apply_patch edits are procedural evidence, not admitted work or receipts.

The original full browser run failed downloads despite 187 passing records. Later bounded runs saved real CSVs and exposed a corrected filename-overwrite assumption, but both notice-wait and ordinary DOM-query failures prevented final browser acceptance. Trials are stopped; no full pass is claimed.
Nine qualified metrics, positive recovery and final full-workflow quality remain unavailable or incomplete.
The separate diagnosis participant passed functional assertions but failed the execution profile; skill activation and causal effectiveness remain unverified.
